roles.STATE_INPUT: compact observed market/trade state; jev-trader uses order-book/mid/spread/position context
roles.DECISION_OUTPUT: typed buy/sell probabilities; hold only on lateness in reference loop
roles.MODEL_DEPENDENCY: TypeSafe Jev optional in repo, with mock fallback for development
roles.RUNTIME: Bun/TypeScript; reference app also binds Monad RPC + Kuru execution
roles.MEMORY_FOOTPRINT: small in-process state/history; no vector DB required by model role
roles.HOT_PATH_LATENCY: reference targets one decision per ~300ms Monad block; README reports ~80ms mock-inference stand-in and ~100ms loop p50 in dry run
roles.RATIONALE: The model-role pattern is valid, but SENEX already has a frozen HYP-008 Jev shadow judgment arm plus authoritative deterministic score. Importing a second market judge would duplicate an existing shadow role; Monad/Kuru execution is explicitly incompatible.

roles.STATE_INPUT: verbatim lead text plus bounded source metadata, primary-evidence links, market family and reproducibility facts
roles.DECISION_OUTPUT: KEEP | REJECT | NEEDS_EVIDENCE plus typed relevance/quality/risk judgments; source text remains unchanged
roles.MODEL_DEPENDENCY: reference implementation uses TypeSafe Jev 1.13.0 typed Choice/Score/Noul; recommended SENEX contract remains provider-neutral
roles.RUNTIME: reference core is Rust with Python/PyO3 bindings and HTTP client; streaming JSONL/Parquet design
roles.MEMORY_FOOTPRINT: streaming/no vector DB; outputs can be append-only research artifacts
roles.HOT_PATH_LATENCY: OUTSIDE_TRADING_HOT_PATH; reference reports ~20 rows/s TypeSafe-rate-limited and ~24 rows/s local mock
EXTERNAL_SERVICES: TypeSafe API if Jev provider selected
roles.RATIONALE: SENEX has no first-class lead curator. This role can screen PolyDekos/FMZ/GitHub leads without changing score/gates/orders. Fail closed to NEEDS_EVIDENCE when primary proof or provider is unavailable, and evaluate marginal value against AUD-labelled lead decisions.

roles.STATE_INPUT: proposal plus observed risk state; Prism additionally uses pool state, fee/IL ratio, drift, TVL velocity and memory
roles.DECISION_OUTPUT: ALLOW-like HOLD vs REBALANCE/EXIT/ENTER under deterministic risk gate
roles.MODEL_DEPENDENCY: reference role is primarily rule-based; vector memory informs observations
roles.RUNTIME: Bun 1.4.x with Solana/Meteora integrations and sqlite-vec memory
roles.MEMORY_FOOTPRINT: persistent SQLite vector memory with expiring patterns/warnings/outcomes
roles.HOT_PATH_LATENCY: 10-minute reference cycle; not designed for SENEX 1h order boundary
roles.RATIONALE: Its valuable property is deterministic fail-closed gating, but SENEX already owns that responsibility in PortfolioEngine/RiskKernel/ExecutionEngine. Solana LP mechanics and vector memory would add infrastructure without a distinct role.

roles.STATE_INPUT: append-only session ledger facts, edits/check results, stop/done claim, optional project rules
roles.DECISION_OUTPUT: deterministic allow/block from facts; optional Jev judgment produces advisory notes rather than blocking
roles.MODEL_DEPENDENCY: Jev optional; deterministic ledger remains authoritative when no key or uncertain judgment
roles.RUNTIME: Node >=22; repository advertises zero runtime dependencies for compiled CLI
roles.MEMORY_FOOTPRINT: append-only per-session ledger files; paths/outcomes, not file contents
roles.HOT_PATH_LATENCY: development hook path, not market path; README describes Jev judgment around a quarter second
roles.RATIONALE: Canny is strong evidence for 'facts block, judgments advise', but current SENEX ARQ/AUD/CI gates already enforce evidence-before-completion. It belongs to engineering harness governance, not a new SENEX subsystem.

roles.STATE_INPUT: text item plus declared evaluation goal
roles.DECISION_OUTPUT: multiple typed 0–4 question scores, weighted aggregate, clarity gate and KILL/FIX/SHIP-style categorical verdict
roles.RUNTIME: Node/Vite server endpoint; optional SQLite analytics archive
roles.MEMORY_FOOTPRINT: none required for scoring; optional SQLite evaluation archive
roles.HOT_PATH_LATENCY: one external Jev evaluation request; outside trading path
roles.RATIONALE: The multi-question typed-scoring template is useful design evidence for STRATEGY_CURATOR, but its startup rubric/thresholds are domain-specific and it should not become a second curator role.

generality_evidence.pattern: symbolic scene→typed tactical judgment; classical safety keeps veto
structured server game state→typed action choices with heuristic fallback

resource_constraints.laya_future_option: separate research worker/sidecar only with explicit sufficient RAM
